Independent exhaustive rational enumeration of all bond configurations on W_n for 3<=n<=6 confirms the finite formula; 295 exact/boundary/limit assertions replayed from the standalone package. Joint Bernoulli-to-Poisson point-process convergence yields the random cut/seed arc limit; matrix exponential computes full-connectivity atom; a tagged-component size-biased gap calculation gives the mean. Boundary cases lambda=0 and mu=0, quantifiers, and weak-versus-total-variation limits are stated. Finite checks are corroborative, not a proof of convergence.

value.rationale: This is a natural two-parameter finite-size reliability window for a canonical spatial graph where rare rim failures compete with rare hub connections. The complete limiting fraction law contains three distinct mass components—an isolation atom, a full-connectivity atom and strictly positive interior mass—and an explicit function of both intensities; single-edge reliability or the one-variable polynomial cannot describe this macroscopic fraction. The Poisson arc mechanism is interpretable for sparse-fault resilience and provides exact critical probabilities. The elementary finite transfer identity alone is not claimed to have independent research value.
